better.method: pooled geometric-mean ratio over all paired episodes, one-sided exact sign test on the paired log ratios, and the fraction of (family, seed) groups whose geometric mean is below 1

bound_destroys.rule: the bounded projected arm fails utility where the unbounded passes, or its pooled k=8 loss exceeds the unbounded's by more than 10%

stage_a_utility.rule: R97W's four utility criteria, in EVERY (family, seed) group

rules.SPECIALIST_SLOT_FUNCTIONAL_NO_CGC_SPECIF: benefit, causal and objective, but not better than G3
rules.adaptive_benefit: arm better than G0 (better rule) with pooled ratio <= 0.80
rules.assay: G0 median k=0 query MSE <= 0.90 x the zero predictor's, in every group
rules.gate: G2 slot-functional and G1 not: GATE_IDENTIFIABILITY_FAILURE; both: GATE_NOT_LIMITING; neither: SPECIALIST_OPERATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED
rules.mode_b: arm better than G0 at k = 0: FROZEN_BENEFIT; else, if slot-functional: ADAPTIVE_SPECIALIST_REQUIRES_INNER_UPDATES

budgets.memory: the d64 expert and 120-parameter learners: well under 1 GiB per process

development.label: DEVELOPMENT ONLY: namespaces R11A_DEV / R11B_DEV, seeds 11, 12, 21; no confirmation seed or episode was used

question: Does a correctly bounded, explicitly specialized expert-local CGCTransform (inside the existing FFN expert) keep R97W's microscopic adaptive behaviour under the transformer adapter, make a causal, specialized and cubic-specific contribution to its expert, and does any of it transfer to frozen-weight inference?

router.rule: learned-router selection is tested only if a specialist qualifies; never oracle routing at inference; oracle-routed success is not learned-routing success

stage_a.outer: first-order Reptile on the core (interpolation 0.28); LEARNED arms add one clipped SGD step on the projections per episode (query loss of the adapted core)
stage_a.primary_metric: held-out query MSE after 8 explicit inner steps on the 120 core parameters

stage_b.branch_initialization: Stage A's projected-adapter rule for every specialist arm (A1 calibration); G1 keeps the historical gate init 0.1
stage_b.checkpoint_selection: per arm, the best DEV-episode k=8 query MSE among checkpoints every 100 steps (same rule for every arm)
stage_b.primary_metric: held-out TEST query MSE after 8 inner steps (Mode A); k = 0 is Mode B
stage_b.profile_rule: BOUNDED_SPECIALIST, unless Stage A's confirmation finds bound_destroys_behavior; then E0_REFERENCE (run_r11 stage_b reads Stage A's records to apply it)

stage_c.rule: Stage C runs only after the trigger, under its own frozen amendment written before any Stage C data; otherwise NOT_RUN with the reason
stage_c.trigger: EXPERT_SPECIALIZATION_QUALIFIED for G1 or G2 in Stage B

stopping: no rerun of a confirmation record
no threshold or endpoint changed after results
no retuning of the bound or the geometry to rescue a result
no second specialist if the first fails
